      "observations": [
        "All 2247 owned diff lines across all 75 Thunderbird/shared paths were read. The change converts source lists to unified compilation and also changes logging, shared identifiers, preference reads, MIME declarations and file-local macro boundaries. It is a functional human infrastructure change, not a formatter exclusion. No assertion or test-body line changes in the owned patch; TestMimeFuzz.cpp changes build registration only.",
        "The original build lists retain six explicit standalone files: nsAbWinHelper.cpp, nsUserInfoWin.cpp, nsImapMailFolder.cpp, MapiMessage.cpp, rtfDecoder.cpp and nsMsgMaildirStore.cpp. The IMAP and Maildir comments state Mac compile-error reasons. Accepted source retains these scoped exceptions and later also excludes nsMessengerWinIntegration.cpp with a windowsx.h macro explanation. That later addition is not attributed to this original patch.",
        "The three Windows address-book implementations remove per-file PRINTF wrappers and inactive console-print alternatives. Plain messages use MOZ_LOG; many formatted values use MOZ_LOG_FMT. Dump changes the format spelling from %02X to {:02x}, and HRESULT formats change to {:08x}. UnicodeToWord retains its MOZ_LOG %S/%s conversion-error branch. Native MAPI formatting equivalence and upstream fmt behavior remain unexecuted and unpaired; the local adoption is not a global logging rule.",
        "The local POP3 move paths stop using the process-wide first-read cache. DeleteMessages reads the preference when deleteStorage and isMove are true; CopyMessages and EndMove read its inverse before their Trash-specific marking. The implementation and calls of GetDeleteFromServerOnMove are removed, but its header declaration remains in both the owned and accepted revision. An exact symbol search found only that declaration; no link or runtime failure is inferred.",
        "IsSummaryFileValid stops using the cached timestamp allowance and its old explicit 60 initializer. It reads Preferences::GetInt locally after initial folder metadata checks, uses equality for zero and an absolute difference otherwise. Both owned and accepted defaults declare 4000. The upstream API missing-value behavior is not established from this call. No preference mutation or summary-file validation was run.",
        "mimebuf.cpp includes its own header and changes buffer_fpP from uint32_t* to int32_t*, matching the existing declaration and MimeObject ibuffer_fp field passed by MimeObject_parse_buffer. The two boundary comparisons no longer cast the signed size. This establishes local declaration/caller agreement, not negative-input validation, overflow safety or an ABI/build result. Accepted CheckedInt growth and two-byte slack are later changes.",
        "The patch adds 29 MIME_SUPERCLASS undef directives and two MAPI_STARTUP_ARG undef directives at the affected file ends. MIME implementations include concrete headers instead of several ad-hoc base-typed extern declarations; the headers declare distinct Related, Alternative, AppleDouble and Multipart class types. Accepted mimemult retains the related and alternative headers and file-end undef. mimeebod.cpp is absent at the accepted revision; no nonexistent current counterpart was inferred. These are local compilation-boundary changes, not an instruction to clear every macro.",
        "Component-specific names preserve stored data: kFolderFlagsColumnName still maps to flags, kRowIDProperty still maps to DbRowID, and shared kEwsIdProperty still maps to ewsId. The Mork reader includes the guarded database header and the database writer uses the same row key. The IMAP guard becomes gImapServiceInitialized with the same false-to-true constructor transition. Accepted Exchange later renames the EWS constant but preserves ewsId; that later naming phase is separate.",
        "Manual review covered affected C++/build roles, conditional boundaries, local naming, header declarations, comments, return paths, format spelling and logical groups. No new deep control flow or new assertions are introduced. Existing unrelated dense branches and assertions are not reclassified as changes in this patch. No source, helper, validator, policy or instruction was edited.",
        "The historical pending marker in the source-only packet is resolved by this separate full join: the exact primary Bug2023736 current comments 0–2 and own D289132 creation-to-final timeline, footer and two actual inline bodies are complete. The original source objects, timestamps and B semantic-reader attribution are retained; C3 remains the original review collector. Raw discussion stays private.",
        "The primary description gives compilation-time improvement as motivation and explicitly mentions folder-specific prerequisites. It supplies no measured Thunderbird benchmark. In D289132 the reviewer reports that it seems to build locally and tentatively thinks it is a little quicker. These are attributed historical reports, not our fresh native build or timing result.",
        "The reviewer actual inline 1575414 proposes MOZ_LOG_FMT and remains Not Done; author inline 1575593 agrees to use the newer facility. Exact owned source adopts MOZ_LOG_FMT for many formatted arguments, while plain MOZ_LOG and UnicodeToWord printf-style formatting remain. The later diff update, remote completion and final close do not expand this local adoption into a repository-wide rule. No summary or test-plan edits exist.",
        "The full source audit keeps the build conversion, six original standalone exceptions, preference-cache removal, signed MIME cursor agreement, concrete class declarations, local undef boundaries and stored-key names separate. Accepted later source includes additional Windows build exclusion and buffer-growth repairs. Those later facts have bounded exact proofs but receive no extra historical audit credit here."
